required_env_vars.name: PATH
required_env_vars.description: System path containing Node.js, npm, Python, FFmpeg, and FFprobe binaries.

optional_env_vars.name: AGY_ENV
optional_env_vars.description: Execution environment tier: 'production', 'test', or 'dev'. Defaults to 'dev'.

optional_env_vars.name: AGY_IS_MANAGED
optional_env_vars.description: Flag indicating managed pipeline invocation ('1' or '0').

optional_env_vars.name: AGY_RUN_ID
optional_env_vars.description: UUID tracking the execution run across distributed tracing spans.

optional_env_vars.name: AGY_SPAN_ID
optional_env_vars.description: Span ID for hierarchical execution tracing.

optional_env_vars.name: SVM_DATA_DIR
optional_env_vars.description: Path to local cache and runtime asset data directory.

optional_env_vars.name: AGY_FAILURE_INJECTION_ENABLED
optional_env_vars.description: Test-only flag to enable failure injection. Hard-blocked in production.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for GPT-based planning and transcription tools.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for ElevenLabs voiceover generation.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for Pexels video/image search.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: PIXABAY_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for Pixabay media search.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: FREESOUND_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for Freesound audio search.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: FAL_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for Fal.ai image generation.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: HEYGEN_API_KEY
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for HeyGen avatar video generation.

secret_bearing_env_vars.name: REPLICATE_API_TOKEN
secret_bearing_env_vars.description: Optional API key for Replicate inference models.

external_binaries.name: python
external_binaries.purpose: Pipeline orchestration, gate enforcement, security checks, test execution

external_binaries.name: npm / npx / npx.cmd
external_binaries.purpose: Remotion bundling, still rendering, and video composition compilation

external_binaries.name: ffmpeg
external_binaries.purpose: Audio loudness normalization, video transcoding, concatenation

external_binaries.name: ffprobe
external_binaries.purpose: Audio/video stream and codec inspection, probe QC frame validation

network_dependent_features: Remote media downloading via media-sources-mcp (Pexels, Pixabay, Freesound)
AI voice generation via ElevenLabs API
Avatar video generation via HeyGen API
offline_capable_features: Probe QC frame rendering & contact sheet generation
All unit, integration, and security test suites

platform_assumptions.shell_assumptions: safe_subprocess forces shell=False across all platforms

platform_limitations.workaround: Safe path resolution relies on canonical Path.resolve() and commonpath containment rather than OS symlinks
